items.title: Popular AI Video Editors & Platforms

items.markdown:
An AI video editor is `a software tool that uses artificial intelligence to automate and assist with video creation, cutting, audio cleanup, and visual effects`.[[1]](https://www.adobe.com/products/firefly/features/ai-video-editor.html)

### Key Capabilities

- **Rough Cuts & Cleanup:** Automatically removes dead air, long pauses, filler words, and bad takes from talking-head videos or interviews.[[1]](https://invideo.io/make/ai-video-editor/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QeiVz_P6F5c&t=16)
- **Text-Based Editing:** Lets you edit video footage by modifying the auto-generated transcript (deleting words in the text cuts the video).[[1]](https://www.opus.pro/ai-video-editor)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QeiVz_P6F5c&t=16)
- **Auto-Reframing:** Converts landscape videos (16:9) into vertical formats (9:16) while keeping the main subject tracked and centered.[[1]](https://invideo.io/make/ai-video-editor/)
- **AI B-Roll & Generation:** Generates missing shots, background music, sound effects, or custom video clips using text prompts.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FAYQieRN5BY&t=6)[[2]](https://invideo.io/make/ai-video-editor/)[[3]](https://www.adobe.com/products/firefly/features/ai-video-editor.html)
- **Scene & Background Manipulation:** Changes backdrops, swaps product colors, or relights scenes using natural language instructions.[[1]](https://runway.com/product/ai-video-editor)



---

### Popular AI Video Editors & Platforms

- **[invideo](https://invideo.io/make/ai-video-editor/)** : Great for turning prompts, scripts, or rough footage into polished videos with automated B-roll and voiceovers.
- **[Runway](https://runway.com/product/ai-video-editor)** : Features *Edit Studio* and the *Aleph 2.0* model for prompt-based video edits, background replacement, and multi-shot consistency.
- **[Higgsfield AI](https://higgsfield.ai/ai-video-editor)** : Focuses on text-prompt video editing, object removal, scene restyling, and upscaling up to 4K.
- **[Adobe Firefly](https://www.adobe.com/products/firefly/features/ai-video-editor.html)** : Integrates generative video tools, text-to-video, and a timeline editor for browser-based or desktop workflows.
- **[Kling AI](https://kling.ai/feature/ai-video-editor)** : Offers AI video extension, subject replacement, background rebuilding, and avatar/lip-sync capabilities.
- **VEED.io & OpusClip** : Specialized tools for rapid social media clipping, auto-subtitles, and short-form content generation.[[1]](https://higgsfield.ai/ai-video-editor)[[2]](https://invideo.io/make/ai-video-editor/)[[3]](https://runway.com/product/ai-video-editor)[[4]](https://www.adobe.com/products/firefly/features/ai-video-editor.html)[[5]](https://kling.ai/feature/ai-video-editor)[[6]](https://www.veed.io/tools/ai-video/ai-video-editor)[[7]](https://www.opus.pro/ai-video-editor)
